juce::MidiFile Class Reference

## Detailed Description

Reads/writes standard midi format files.

To read a midi file, create a [MidiFile](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiFile.html "Reads/writes standard midi format files.") object and call its [readFrom()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiFile.html#a943c5fba6233961f7d9eea5cf9da63be "Reads a midi file format stream.") method. You can then get the individual midi tracks from it using the [getTrack()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiFile.html#ac8d26f1b81f9e5bdd21361f89e9ee4ca "Returns a pointer to one of the tracks in the file.") method.

To write a file, create a [MidiFile](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiFile.html "Reads/writes standard midi format files.") object, add some [MidiMessageSequence](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiMessageSequence.html "A sequence of timestamped midi messages.") objects to it using the [addTrack()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiFile.html#a227e2edcdb92091495de8b545c054f08 "Adds a midi track to the file.") method, and then call its [writeTo()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiFile.html#aee9dcc166feea5a8d6e2b40d66189ce8 "Writes the midi tracks as a standard midi file.") method to stream it out.

See also[MidiMessageSequence](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiMessageSequence.html "A sequence of timestamped midi messages.")

| short juce::MidiFile::getTimeFormat | ( |  | ) | const | | noexcept |

Returns the raw time format code that will be written to a stream.

After reading a midi file, this method will return the time-format that was read from the file's header. It can be changed using the [setTicksPerQuarterNote()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiFile.html#a268f311766c447c23b50c964daf25207 "Sets the time format to use when this file is written to a stream.") or [setSmpteTimeFormat()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiFile.html#a68bcc521fcc580f2956158c1d9609588 "Sets the time format to use when this file is written to a stream.") methods.

If the value returned is positive, it indicates the number of midi ticks per quarter-note - see [setTicksPerQuarterNote()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiFile.html#a268f311766c447c23b50c964daf25207 "Sets the time format to use when this file is written to a stream.").

It it's negative, the upper byte indicates the frames-per-second (but negative), and the lower byte is the number of ticks per frame - see [setSmpteTimeFormat()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiFile.html#a68bcc521fcc580f2956158c1d9609588 "Sets the time format to use when this file is written to a stream.").

juce::MidiFile Class Reference

Detailed Description

Reads/writes standard midi format files.

To read a midi file, create a MidiFile object and call its readFrom() method. You can then get the individual midi tracks from it using the getTrack() method.

To write a file, create a MidiFile object, add some MidiMessageSequence objects to it using the addTrack() method, and then call its writeTo() method to stream it out.

See also
MidiMessageSequence

◆ getTimeFormat()

short juce::MidiFile::getTimeFormat ( ) const
noexcept

Returns the raw time format code that will be written to a stream.

After reading a midi file, this method will return the time-format that was read from the file's header. It can be changed using the setTicksPerQuarterNote() or setSmpteTimeFormat() methods.

If the value returned is positive, it indicates the number of midi ticks per quarter-note - see setTicksPerQuarterNote().

It it's negative, the upper byte indicates the frames-per-second (but negative), and the lower byte is the number of ticks per frame - see setSmpteTimeFormat().
